Name: Random Monster Drops
Author: exarobibliologist
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This makes every monster drop one single extra item (randomly pulled from the entire catalog of possible items in the game—modded included).[/color][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8]Because the regular monster drops are usually required for quests, building, donations to museum or community center, etc... this mod [b][u]DOES NOT replace[/u][/b] monster drops with random items. It [b][u]ADDS an additional drop[/u][/b] to each monster—this means monsters that don't drop anything are guaranteed to drop one item, and monsters that drop something will drop their normal drop AND one additional item!  If you are using the Burglar's Ring, then you have a chance of getting two random items per monster! [/color]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This will overwhelm your inventory FAST!![/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]I did not add a filter to prevent quest items or tools from being in the random drops, so this will unbalance a game as well. [/color][/size][color=#d4d4d8]I wasn't sure whether to put this under Gameplay Mechanics or Cheats... you can decide for yourself... (let me know if I should re-categorize this based on your game)[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Install using Vortex, OR unzip the archive your Mods folder[/color][/size]

[b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]No requirements... Just kill things and get treasure.[/color][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]Recommends[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54186]Infinite Inventory[/url] to handle the overwhelming number of items you end up getting.[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3782]Ship Anything[/url] which will let you sell the junk and unusable random items you get from this. [/color]

Manifest.Name: Random Monster Drops
Manifest.Description: Every slain monster drops its normal loot plus one completely random item from the entire vanilla and modded catalog.
